title: Read the following two primary source excerpts and answer the prompt below.

documents.label: A
documents.citation: Calvin Coolidge, address to the American Society of Newspaper Editors, Washington, D.C., January 17, 1925 (White House press release / Congressional Record, public domain)
documents.excerpt: The chief business of the American people is business. They are profoundly concerned with producing, buying, selling, investing and prospering in the world…Advertising ministers to the spiritual side of trade. It is a great power that has been entrusted to your keeping which charges you with the high responsibility of inspiring and ennobling the commercial motives and ideals of America.

documents.label: B
documents.citation: U.S. Senate Banking and Currency Committee Report on the Stock Market Crash, 1931 (U.S. Government Printing Office, public domain)
documents.excerpt: The decade of the nineteen-twenties saw a vast increase in the use of credit for the purchase of securities…The very ease with which credit was obtained, the persistently advancing prices of securities, and the large profits made by those who bought on margin all combined to attract new participants into the market…When the collapse came, it came with a completeness and a speed that took even the most experienced observers by surprise.
